hero.heading: Mediterranean Cuisine Course in Dhaka
hero.subheading: Master the world's healthiest diet. Learn Greek, Italian, and Levantine classics with premium olive oil, fresh herbs, and seafood.

overview.title: The Bounty of the Mediterranean
overview.text:
The Mediterranean diet is globally celebrated for its health benefits, relying on olive oil, fresh citrus, rich garlic, and aromatic herbs. As healthy eating trends grow in Dhaka, premium cafes and health-conscious food setups require chefs specialized in Mediterranean gastronomy.

From blending velvety smooth hummus to baking fresh pita and grilling seafood with traditional spice rubs, this course covers the vibrant flavors of Greece, Italy, and the Levant.

highlights.title: Levantine Dips
highlights.description: Prepare smooth Hummus, Baba Ganoush, and garlic Tzatziki.

highlights.title: Seafood Grills
highlights.description: Learn direct-fire grilling for sea bass, calamari, and prawns.

highlights.title: Flatbreads & Pita
highlights.description: Bake fresh pita bread and dynamic manakeesh from scratch.

highlights.title: Olive Oil Dressings
highlights.description: Master emulsion sauces and fresh herb vinaigrettes.

features: Making authentic Levant flatbreads and fresh pita bread
Blending emulsified dressings and olive oil vinaigrettes

faqs.question: What ingredients will we work with?
faqs.answer: We provide premium Extra Virgin Olive Oil, Tahini, fresh herbs, chickpeas, lamb, and seafood for all practical sessions.

faqs.question: Is this course suitable for home makers?
faqs.answer: Yes. It is excellent for homemakers who wish to cook healthy, restaurant-quality Mediterranean meals for their families or start a healthy cloud kitchen.

cta.subheading: Gain the skills to cook healthy, vibrant, and incredibly delicious Mediterranean classics.
